name: Anchorage
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Anchorage for 2026, and here is what he found: 21 family events, 8 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Zoo Lights, The Nutcracker with Eugene Ballet and the North Pole Express Christmas Lights Tour) through January 3 (Zoo Lights and Brighter Winter Nights), with the Anchorage Holiday Tree Lighting on 4th Avenue (November 28), TubaChristmas (December 6) and the Downtown Anchorage New Year's Eve Celebration (December 31) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Anchorage

  • Parades and tree lightings: the Anchorage Holiday Tree Lighting on 4th Avenue on November 28 and the downtown New Year's Eve celebration on December 31
